description: Liste des bornes de recharges disponibles 2020 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Prise de Nice. 79 charging stations. Coverage: Prise de Nice. The portal shows the English title as "List of charging stations available 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Prise de Nice. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2019-12-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
